$comment: Single source of truth for the JS<->WASM ABI: packed-snapshot field layouts, shared enums, and the version stamp. `npm run generate:abi` emits cpp/engine/abi.generated.hpp and wasmBridge/abi.generated.js; the wasm build fails if they are stale. Bump abiVersion on ANY layout/enum change — initSandWasm() refuses a module whose engine_abi_version() mismatches, which catches a stale committed sandEngine.js immediately.

playerSnapshot.$comment: float32 records built by buildPlayerSnapshot (player.inc); read by engineFactory.getPlayers/getPlayer and the net layer.

itemSnapshot.$comment: float32 records built by buildItemSnapshot (items.inc); also the external GL item layout (glSetItems) and the ITEMS wire message payload.

creatureSnapshot.$comment: float32 creature records built by CreatureSystem; also used by the external GL renderer and CREATURES wire message.

inventorySlot.$comment: float32 records built by buildInventorySnapshot / buildCursorSnapshot (inventory.inc). The cursor snapshot uses the same layout with `selected` unused.

glPlayerExt.$comment: float32 records a multiplayer client packs for engine_gl_set_players (host-authoritative snapshot players).

perfSnapshot.$comment: double records written by engine_perf_snapshot. Fine step phases accumulate across both layers; counts are totals for the last step. Bump abiVersion on layout change.

PlayerInput.$comment: Input bitmask (player.inc / the browser input layer / the net protocol).

Tool.$comment: Legacy tool ids (tools.inc); the creative palette prefers setCreativeMaterial.

CreativeKind.$comment: What an engine_set_creative_material selection refers to.

CreatureSpecies.$comment: Creature species ids used by snapshots, test hooks, and the network renderer.

constants.$comment: Shared scalar constants. INV_SLOTS must equal INV_HOTBAR + the grid size (asserted in common.hpp).
